title: Ongoing psionic operation in the Pentagon
summary: Ross Coulthart tells of Ongoing psionic operation in the Pentagon, about present at The Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: spoken to people who've confirmed that there is still an ongoing psionic operation being run in the Pentagon.

plain: Ross Coulthart, a journalist, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that he has spoken to people who confirmed a psionic operation is still running inside the Pentagon, the headquarters of the US Defense Department in Arlington, Virginia. "Psionic" here means work that uses the mind's claimed psychic powers. If true, it would mean the military still takes psychic abilities seriously today.
